a chemokine receptor (CCR1 and CCR2) antagonist inhibits experimental tumor growth.
a chemokine receptor CCL5 antagonist inhibits tumor growth by inhibiting macrophage infiltration.
a chemokine receptor inhibitor, Met-RANTES, inhibits experimental breast cancer growth.

the development of a novel therapeutic approach to cancer treatment based on the modulation of the immune system.
the role of chemokines, which are a family of small secreted proteins, in the development and progression of breast cancer.
understanding the role of macrophages in the development of breast cancer.
